**What the platform declares for this seat**

The seat's declared policy ("Production Worker") says its reachable domains are manufacturing, inventory, sales, core and agent; that it is not read-only; and that it caps queries at 100 records. It declares these entities denied: Coupon, AgentPersona, AgentToolPolicy, AgentFloorConfig, ApprovalRequest, ApprovalPolicy.

One caveat: these rows configure the platform's *hosted persona*, not this seat. So I checked the real limits with seat_capability instead of repeating the declaration.

**What this seat can really reach (confirmed)**

- Work orders: read and write — WorkOrder.get/list/create/update, plus complete, submit, start_production, stop, resume, approval.submit, make.QualityInspection, make.SubcontractOrder. No delete operation exists.
- Sales orders: read-only — SalesOrder.get, SalesOrder.list, SalesOrder.make.WorkOrder. There is no SalesOrder.update operation.
- Confirmed usable: BOM, JobCard, DowntimeEntry, EngineeringChangeOrder, MaterialRequest, Workstation, SubcontractOrder (all .list).
- Employee, SalarySlip and ApprovalRequest exist on the platform but are outside this seat (REST 403).

**What needs a human's approval (declared, not verifiable by me)**

The declared approval list covers: any delete; changing a work order's planned_end_date (single or bulk); and changing a sales order's delivery_date or expected_shipment_date (single or bulk). This seat has no ApprovalPolicy or ApprovalRequest visibility, so I cannot confirm how that approval step is enforced — treat it as a platform-side control.

**Divergences the platform itself flags (not my permissions)**

The declared policy denies AgentPersona, AgentToolPolicy and AgentFloorConfig, but this seat can read them. The platform's own note says this is a question for the platform owners, not permission for this seat to act — I'm reporting it, not relying on it.

**Not visible to me**

Employee, SalarySlip, ApprovalRequest. Because Employee is out of reach, I cannot provide anyone's contact details, and any request to call or contact people would have to be refused as a whole.
